name: 末日公会 Apocalypse Guild
detailed_description:
Apocalypse Guild is a challenging Japanese-style roguelike turn-based RPG that focuses on resource management and skill combos during adventures.

Recruit, train, lead, and manage a group of heroes with unique personalities as you traverse abandoned suburbs, eternally dark cemeteries, and thorn-filled forests. You’ll not only battle powerful enemies but also manage combat resources and distribute loot to the right heroes. Can you restore hope to humanity, strengthen your guild, and fight against the impending apocalypse in this unique strategic turn-based combat system?

Unique Turn-Based Combat System: Inspired by games like Hearthstone, Pokémon, Darkest Dungeon, and Slay the Spire.

Faith and Bond System: A game-wide mechanic where defeated adventurers in battle will either hold their ground or retreat based on their Faith and Bond. In daily life, your adventurers will either support or reject your proposals based on these attributes.

Personal and Guild Property Mechanics: Each adventurer has their own personal property, leading to loot distribution, negotiation, and trading dynamics.

Resume System: Send your adventurers to face challenges in different regions to gain experience and grow.

Promotion and Salary System: Promotions and salary increases enhance character abilities but also raise their compensation. Balance character growth with financial management.

Guild System Voting: Organize votes among all adventurers to change guild policies, including taxation and loot distribution.

Rescue Assistance System: For adventurers who flee in battle, you can issue a rescue code to seek help from other guild leaders across different timelines.

No Idle Members: Adventurers not in combat can contribute to logistics and support operations.
